name: Lopamudra Mishra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Lopamudra Mishra’s English poems in Kabita Live explore the ways affection changes a person’s sense of self. In ‘I left behind’, familiar songs, books and dance steps give way to a life reshaped through companionship. The sky and stars remain the same while the speaker describes becoming someone new.

‘I woke up thinking about you’ makes a relationship audible through melody, rhythm and remembered words. A different energy animates ‘I am born different’: woodland, wind and imagined wings accompany a speaker seeking room beyond expectations. Together, these poems move between intimacy and the desire to preserve an individual voice.
